author: Vydm
quote:
10/10 – An Unmatched Masterpiece That Defined Gaming Forever
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time isn’t just the greatest game of 1998—it is the gold standard by which all 3D action-adventure games are still measured today. Nintendo successfully translated the magic of Hyrule into a breathtaking three-dimensional world, introducing revolutionary mechanics like Z-targeting and context-sensitive buttons that permanently shaped modern game design.
From the nostalgic tranquility of Kokiri Forest to the haunting, atmospheric depths of the Shadow Temple, every single dungeon feels brilliantly crafted and distinct. The pacing is flawless, weaving together clever puzzles, intense boss battles, and a deeply emotional coming-of-age story about time, duty, and loss. Combined with Koji Kondo’s iconic, unforgettable soundtrack—where playing the ocarina itself becomes an integral part of the gameplay—this game achieves pure perfection. Nearly three decades later, its sense of wonder and adventure remains completely untouchable. An absolute 10/10 must-play.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Vydm
quote: What a boring game. The only thing going for it is the visual upgrade, because there is zero innovation here—it’s basically just The Sims with better graphics. Without any fresh mechanics, depth, or charm to keep you engaged, it gets repetitive fast. Definitely not worth the money.
